title: Will Forever by The Big Moon have above 2000 Album Equivalent Units during the October 30, 2026 - November 05, 2026 tracking week? Above 2K
rules: If Forever by The Big Moon has above 2K Album Equivalent Units during the October 30, 2026 - November 05, 2026, tracking week, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
IMPORTANT INFORMATION: This event pertains to the U.S. and will resolve based on the value reported by Luminate’s API as of 10:00 AM ET on the Sunday immediately following the October 30, 2026 - November 05, 2026 tracking week.

Luminate Data, LLC is a neutral provider of market metrics which does not endorse, verify or participate in any way in the outcomes of any prediction market.

blind.reasoning: Forever is a UK indie band's fourth album, released Oct 30, 2026, so the market covers its first US week. The Big Moon have a small US audience, and their tour and in-store dates are all in the UK. Reaching 2,000 US album-equivalent units would take roughly 2,000 sales or about 2.5 million on-demand streams in one week, which is far above what a band this size usually does in the US.
blind.falsifier: Luminate reports more than 2,000 US album-equivalent units for Forever in its debut week, for example because of a large US vinyl or bundle sale or a viral US streaming surge.

final.reasoning: The 0.175 midpoint hints traders see more US demand than I do, so I moved up slightly. But 2,000 US first-week units for a UK-focused indie band with UK-only promotion still looks unlikely, so the price seems too high.
